is.t: Update store profile with all valid data
Logged in as Seller 1 (Approved). Store Settings page is open.

1. Change Store Name, Description and Contact Number to the test data. 2. Upload the logo and the banner. 3. Click Save. 4. Refresh the Store Settings page. 5. Log in as Buyer 1 in another browser and open Seller 1's store page. 6. Search for 'Maria Clara Handicrafts PH' as Buyer 1.
Store Name: Maria Clara Handicrafts PH Description: Handwoven bags and home decor from Bulacan artisans. Contact Number: 09189876543 Logo: store_logo.png (300 KB) Banner: store_banner.jpg (1.8 MB)

A success message is shown. After refresh every field shows the saved value. The buyer's store page shows the new name, description, logo and banner, and the store search finds the new name. The old name no longer appears anywhere on the buyer side. No other store's data changes.
Logged in as Seller 1 (Approved). Store Settings page is open.
1. Clear Store Name and click Save. 2. Refresh, clear Contact Number and click Save. 3. Refresh, clear Pickup Address (each part) and click Save. 4. Refresh the page after each attempt.
Clear in turn: Store Name, Contact Number, Region, City / Municipality, Barangay, Street Address
Each attempt is blocked. A required-field message appears on the blank field only. After refresh, the original values are still saved; nothing was changed.
Logged in as Seller 1 (Approved). Store Settings page is open.
1. Enter only spaces in Store Name. 2. Click Save.
Saving is blocked with the required-field message (spaces are trimmed, so the field counts as empty). The old store name is kept.
Store name already used by another store
Logged in as Seller 1 (Approved). Store Settings page is open.
1. Enter each store name in the test data, one per attempt. 2. Click Save each time.
RV Gadget Hub rv gadget hub ' RV Gadget Hub ' (with leading and trailing spaces)
All three are blocked with a message that the store name is already taken (the check ignores case and leading or trailing spaces). Seller 1's name is unchanged.
Store name length at the limits
Logged in as Seller 1 (Approved). Store Settings page is open.
1. Enter each store name in the test data, one per attempt. 2. Click Save each time and note the result.
2 characters: MC (reject) 3 characters: MCH (accept) 30 characters: Maria Clara Handicrafts Bulaca (accept) 31 characters: Maria Clara Handicrafts Bulacan (reject)
2 and 31 characters are rejected with a message stating the 3–30 character limit. 3 and 30 characters are saved exactly as typed. The field does not silently cut off the 31st character.
Logged in as Seller 1 (Approved). Store Settings page is open.
1. Paste a 500-character description and save. 2. Paste a 501-character description and save.
500 characters are saved and shown in full on the store page. 501 characters are rejected with a limit message, or the field stops input at 500; the saved text is never cut silently after saving.
Logged in as Seller 1 (Approved). Store Settings page is open.
1. Enter each contact number, one per attempt, and save.
09189876543 (accept) +639189876543 (accept) 0918987654 (10 digits, reject) 091898765432 (12 digits, reject) 0918-ABC-6543 (reject) 08189876543 (does not start with 09, reject)
Only the two valid Philippine mobile formats are accepted. Each invalid value shows a format message and nothing is saved.
Logo and banner file type and size
Logged in as Seller 1 (Approved). Store Settings page is open.
1. Upload each file as the logo, one at a time, and save. 2. Repeat every file as the banner. 3. Refresh after each attempt.
size_4.9MB.jpg (accept) size_5.0MB.jpg (accept) size_5.1MB.jpg (reject) price_list.docx (reject) installer.exe (reject) renamed_exe.jpg (reject)

The 4.9 MB and 5.0 MB images are accepted. The 5.1 MB file, the DOCX, the EXE and the renamed EXE are rejected with a message naming the allowed types and the 5 MB limit. After a rejection the previous logo or banner is still shown.
Logged in as Seller 1 (Approved). Store is Open. Buyer 1 has P-02 in the cart.
1. Turn on vacation mode and save. 2. As Buyer 1, open the store page and P-02. 3. Click Add to Cart and Buy Now. 4. Open the cart, select P-02 and click Check Out. 5. As Buyer 2, search for P-02.

P-02 still appears in search and on the store page with an 'On vacation' label. Add to Cart and Buy Now are disabled. Checkout of the cart item is blocked with a vacation message. No order can be created for any Seller 1 product while vacation mode is on.
Logged in as Seller 1 (Approved). Vacation mode is on. Buyer 1 has P-02 in the cart.
1. Turn off vacation mode and save. 2. As Buyer 1, refresh P-02. 3. Check out the cart item by COD.
The 'On vacation' label is gone, Add to Cart and Buy Now are enabled, and the order is placed normally.
Seller that is not Approved tries to publish
1. Add a product with all valid data. 2. Click Publish. 3. Click Save as Draft. 4. As Buyer 1, search for the product name.
Product: Handwoven Coin Purse, ₱120.00, stock 10, 0.1 kg, product_front.jpg
Publish is disabled or blocked with a message that the store must be approved first. Save as Draft succeeds and the product shows as Draft. The product does not appear anywhere on the buyer side.
Script and HTML in text fields
Logged in as Seller 1 (Approved). Store Settings page is open.
1. Enter the test data in Description. 2. Save and open the store page as Buyer 1. 3. Open the browser console.
The text is shown literally or with the tags removed. No pop-up appears, no image error triggers a script, and the console shows no script execution.
Seller cannot edit another store's settings
1. Open Store Settings and note the store ID in the URL or request. 2. Change it to Seller 2's store ID and reload or resend the save request.
Access is denied (403, not found, or redirect). No Seller 2 data is shown and nothing about Seller 2's store changes.
